receipt.public_excerpt: OpenAI has closed its latest financing round with $122bn in committed capital, giving the AI company a post-money valuation of $852bn.

evidence_items.explanation: OpenAI's $122B round falls inside the nine-month window and is the largest part of the $217B total.

receipt.public_excerpt: We have raised $30 billion in Series G funding led by GIC and Coatue, valuing Anthropic at $380 billion post-money.

evidence_items.explanation: Anthropic's $30B Series G is inside the window. It was led by GIC and Coatue, not the four named firms, and includes only 'a portion' of Microsoft and NVIDIA's earlier commitments.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic has raised $65 billion in Series H funding led by Altimeter Capital, Dragoneer, Greenoaks, and Sequoia Capital, valuing the company at $965 billion post-money.

evidence_items.explanation: With e1 and e2, this gives $122B + $30B + $65B = $217B in the window, matching his total on a committed-capital basis.

receipt.public_excerpt: Amazon leads the round with a total investment commitment of $50bn, starting with $15bn and planning an additional $35bn subject to future conditions. Nvidia and SoftBank are each investing $30bn.

evidence_items.explanation: Upper bound on the four firms' share. In OpenAI's round, Amazon ($50B) and NVIDIA ($30B) plus at most $9B from Microsoft. In Anthropic's rounds, at most $15B each. That is at most $119B of $217B, about 55%. Not a vast majority.

receipt.public_excerpt: Anthropic and OpenAI probably made up 15–20% of the world’s operational AI compute at the end of 2025.

evidence_items.explanation: A tentative estimate of the two labs' share of installed compute, far below 70-80%. It measures compute used, not new demand or revenue, and is from late 2025, so it does not settle part (a).

unresolved_gaps: No source measures OpenAI and Anthropic's share of 'all AI revenues and compute demand' around September 2026.
Microsoft's amount in OpenAI's round is undisclosed; the e4 bound assumes the most possible.
About $35B of Amazon's OpenAI commitment is conditional, so cash actually received is lower than $217B.
